  PROBLEM: The redactor removes token values and URL userinfo but leaves the origin URL's host and path in the exception.
  WHY: Redaction turns `https://x-access-token:<token>@github.com/o/r` into `https://***@github.com/o/r`, which `persist_memory_operation` includes in the `MemoryGitError`. This contradicts the requirement that the message not contain the origin URL.
